evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-14"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-14". A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The date is a plain YYYY-MM-DD calendar date with no time part.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/3 {"dueDate":"2026-09-01"} returned 200 and the new date. PATCH with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null, so the date can be removed. GET /todos/1 afterwards confirmed the removal.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "15.10.2026" and "2026-10-15T10:00:00Z" each returned 400 with 'dueDate must be a valid YYYY-MM-DD date or null'. PATCH with "2026-02-30" and "bad" also returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-15. The todos were: past 10-14 (not done), today 10-15, one dated 2026-12-01 and later changed to 2026-09-01, one with no date, and one dated 2026-01-01 marked done. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the 10-14 todo and the 09-01 todo. The due-today, no-date and done todos were excluded.
evidence.AC5: The list page at / showed each due date in the list items, for example 'past 14.10.2026 überfällig', 'today 15.10.2026' and 'future 01.09.2026 überfällig'. The todo without a date showed none.
evidence.AC6: On the page, the 14.10.2026 and 01.09.2026 todos carried the word 'überfällig'. The due-today todo, the no-date todo and the done todo with a past date ('donepast ✓ 01.01.2026') did not.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled 'nur überfällige'. After I clicked it, the list showed only 'past 14.10.2026 überfällig' and 'future 01.09.2026 überfällig'.
